description:
Safety check to run BEFORE buying, holding, or recommending a token. Returns an actionable verdict (low / medium / high / unknown), a 0-100 risk score, and the individual signals behind it.
Covers on every chain: liquidity depth, trading-pair age, cross-chain presence, same-ticker impersonation.
Covers on Ethereum, BSC and Base only: sell simulation (honeypot detection, buy/sell/transfer taxes), whether the contract is open source, and the aggregate verdicts of upstream security scanners.
Covers on Solana: the mint/freeze authority, the RugCheck score, and the SPL Token-2022 extension block -- non-transferable, frozen-by-default, transfer fee (with its cap), permanent delegate, transfer hook, pausable, close authority, scaled balances and interest-bearing balances. Every other extension the report carries is named in the answer with the reason it is not scored, so silence about one means it was considered, not that it went unread.
A compatible chain_hint is a network preference. If the initial market listing contains only other networks, VetAgent checks the preferred network first. When a different market is used, network_selection and the recommendation identify the scope of the rating. That rating does not cover the requested network.
No sell simulation runs on Solana, nor on the four other EVM chains accepted as a chain_hint (polygon, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche): nothing there tests whether a holder can sell, so the answer comes back 'unknown' rather than 'low'. On Solana, holder concentration is reported only when RugCheck supplies a holder list; missing lists remain a coverage gap. Identified liquidity-pool accounts are excluded when matching identities are available; otherwise the reported share may include pools. This check is unavailable on EVM.
IMPORTANT: risk_level 'unknown' means a critical check could not be completed. It is NOT a low-risk result and must not be used to justify a trade; evidence.data_gaps lists exactly what was missing, and unknown_kind says whose gap it is: 'infrastructure' and 'mixed' mean an upstream of ours failed and come with next_action 'retry' and retry_after_seconds (in a 'mixed' answer the rest was worked out without that upstream, so the retry can change any of it); 'coverage' comes with 'abstain'. 'confidence' measures how complete the input data was, not how safe the token is.
evidence.pool_link compares the final displayed market with the source-reported pool of the adopted simulator response. same/different describe those identities; unknown means the comparison could not be established. This does not compare a discovered or alerted pool, and same does not establish a successful simulation.
Reports observable on-chain risk only. Not financial advice, does not size positions, and cannot see off-chain risk such as team behaviour, social engineering, or a rug executed through governance. Treat 'low' as 'no fatal signal found in the checks that ran', never as 'safe to buy'.

address.description: Token contract address: ERC-20 (0x + 40 hex) or Solana (base58)

chain_hint.description: Optional chain name (ethereum / bsc / base / polygon / arbitrum / solana). Strongly recommended: Ethereum forks such as PulseChain inherit contract addresses, so the same address exists on several chains at wildly different prices. Without it, an answer covers one chain -- the one holding the most depth -- and names it.

verbose.description: Return full upstream evidence. Off by default to save tokens.

name: assess_token_risk

checked_at.description: When this answer was made, ISO-8601 UTC.

confidence.description: How complete the input data was — not how safe the token is.

driver.description: The signal that decided the verdict: {name, category}. null when nothing above ok fired.

pool_id.description: Complete validated ID of the final displayed market, available in compact and verbose replies. EVM IDs are 20 or 32 bytes; Solana IDs decode to 32 bytes and retain case.

chain_searched.description: Assessment search scope. It can come from the request hint when no market was observed.

max_sell.description: Optional per-sell cap reported by the adopted successful Honeypot.is simulation. Amount is an exact nonnegative uint256 decimal string in smallest units of the assessed token, not the paired asset. A displayed market is required. Missing does not mean unlimited. pool_link qualifies correspondence to the displayed market; different/unknown does not establish its cap. This is not a wallet-specific execution guarantee.

owner_powers.description: Optional, incomplete bytecode observations; not a current-permission audit.

current_authority.description: Authority, activation and reachability were not observed.

evidence_basis.description: Matched selectors are code indicators, not verified callable actions or evidence of present control.

found_none.description: True means this incomplete scan found no mapped selector. It does not prove absence of permissions.

is_proxy.description: Proxy-wrapper indicator; wrapper observations do not establish implementation permissions.

matched_selectors.description: Existing capability labels mapped to the unique lowercase eight-hex selectors matched in the observed bytecode.

powers.description: Legacy capability labels for code indicators, not verified actions or current control.

scan_is_incomplete.description: The bytecode scan does not cover every permission mechanism.

selectors_dispatched.description: Number of dispatch selectors recognized by the incomplete scan.

unavailable.description: Reason for a failed or unusable bytecode observation, not a completed no-match scan.

pool_link.description: Correspondence between the final displayed market and the source-reported venue of the adopted simulator response. same/different compare those identities; unknown means the comparison could not be established. The discovered or alerted pool is not compared. Even same does not establish simulation success, safety, or wallet/amount-specific executability.

pool_link_details.description: Verbose-only correspondence facts for the final displayed market and adopted simulator response. The market and reported IDs are complete when available.

adopted_response.description: Which simulator response the existing engine retained.

market_chain.description: Known chain of the final displayed market.

market_pool.description: Complete validated pool ID of the final displayed market.

policy_chain.description: Existing engine validation/coverage context, not an observed chain.

reason.description: Why correspondence is unknown; null for same or different.

reported_chain.description: Known, consistent chain declared by the adopted response; null when unknown.

reported_pool.description: Valid, consistent 20-byte EVM venue declared by the adopted response.

requested_chain.description: Chain actually encoded in the simulator request, not a source observation.

requested_pool.description: Explicit pool request for the adopted response; never fills a missing report.

retry.description: Only present when a pool-scoped retry occurred.

accepted.description: Whether the retry replaced the default response.

transfer_fee_bps.description: Reported Token-2022 rates in basis points, older then newer. Null means unreadable. The active period is not established.

transfer_fee_max_raw.description: Legacy numeric caps, older then newer, present only when both are readable.

transfer_fee_max_raw_exact.description: Exact u64 caps in smallest token units, older then newer, as decimal strings. Null means unreadable. Prefer these strings in clients that cannot represent all u64 values as numbers.

evidence_max_age_seconds.description: Request-level upper bound on local cache residence observed when JSON is returned from cache and usable cached bytecode is reused during the request. JSON later rejected or replaced still counts; this is not the precise age of only the finally adopted evidence. Positive fractions round up to whole seconds; negative clock skew counts as zero. Bytecode may use a longer cache TTL. Zero means no positive local cache residence was recorded; it does not prove that upstream observations are live or currently executable.

network_selection.description: Requested network, observed market scope and outcome of the extra DexScreener lookup. An empty listing differs from an unconfirmed lookup.

risk_level.description: 'unknown' means a critical check could not be completed. It is NOT a low-risk result and must not justify a trade.

unknown_kind.description: Present only when risk_level is unknown.

title: Assess Token Risk
